Rotate, shift, scale and shear training images at random.

Each training image is rotated by an angle from [-degrees, degrees], shifted by up to translate_x of its width and translate_y of its height (whole pixels), scaled by a factor from scale_min to scale_max and sheared by shear_x / shear_y degrees, about its centre (torchvision RandomAffine); pixels from outside the image take fill. Validation and test images pass through unchanged.

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Degrees | `degrees` | Number | `10` | `0-180` | The run | Largest rotation in degrees, either way. |
| Shift x | `translate_x` | Number | `0.1` | `0-1` | The run | Largest shift, as a fraction of the width. |
| Shift y | `translate_y` | Number | `0.1` | `0-1` | The run | Largest shift, as a fraction of the height. |
| Scale min | `scale_min` | Number | `0.9` | `>0` | The run | Smallest scale factor. |
| Scale max | `scale_max` | Number | `1.1` | `>0` | The run | Largest scale factor. |
| Shear x min | `shear_x_min` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Smallest shear along x, degrees. |
| Shear x max | `shear_x_max` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Largest shear along x, degrees. |
| Shear y min | `shear_y_min` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Smallest shear along y, degrees. |
| Shear y max | `shear_y_max` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Largest shear along y, degrees. |
| Interpolation | `interpolation` | Choice | `nearest` | `nearest`, `bilinear` | The run | Pixel sampling. |
| Fill | `fill` | Number | `0` | `0-1` | The run | Value of the pixels from outside the image (0 = black) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Random Affine is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Random Affine -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Angle from [-degrees, degrees], shift up to translate_x / translate_y of the side in whole pixels, scale from scale_min to scale_max, shears from their ranges, all about the centre; pixels from outside the image take fill. Validation and test pass through.
```

## Tips

- Keeps one random geometry step instead of Image Rotate plus a crop.
